data.name: Ramki
data.gender_notes: Ramki is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ram means 'God' and Ki means 'residing in heart'. So, Ramki means 'God in heart'. The name Ramki carries the meaning “God in heart” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Tamil. Parents who choose Ramki usually hope their child will grow to embody god in heart and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ramki is a spiritual name that represents the presence of God in one's heart. It is a reminder to keep God close to one's heart at all times.
data.etymology: Ramki belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God in heart.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramki total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

Individuals named Ramki may be revered and looked up to within their Hindu communities, given the strong association to a revered deity.
